exposure: Prolonged duration of second stage of labor
cohort: The study included 3054 full-term infants who underwent eye examinations within one week of birth.
finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery, prolonged duration of second stage of labor, advanced maternal age, and neonatal intracranial hemorrhage were positively correlated with the aggravation of the degree of retinal hemorrhage in newborns.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was a risk factor for aggravation of RH, while cesarean section was protective against the incidence of RH.
